data.description:
## Context / Problem
A single Gerrit Verified run needs 21 concurrent job slots. The navapbc org is on GitHub Free: 20 total concurrent jobs and 5 concurrent macOS, enforced PER ORGANIZATION and shared with every other navapbc repo. So one run, in an otherwise idle org, cannot fully parallelize — and under a 6-change burst later runs queued 6.7-8.4m for a macOS slot, which is what turns a ~21m run into the 41-47m seen from Gerrit.

`.github/workflows/_optionality.yml` contributes 8 of those 21 jobs. Each does 0.4-0.8m of real work but pays a full checkout + setup-python + pip install and consumes a slot for the duration.

## Approach
Two independent reductions, neither of which weakens the optionality contract.

1. DELETE the `import-linter` job. It installs `-e .[dev]` — the SAME environment as the `test` matrix cells — and runs `pytest tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py tests/unit/test_optional.py`. Verified: those two files carry NO pytest markers and their 9 tests collect under `-m "not integration and not external"`, so all four `test` matrix cells in `_build-and-test.yml` already run them in the identical environment. `build-and-test` is in `vote.needs`, so the gating survives. The tests are AST-based plus a clean-subprocess `sys.modules` leak check; neither depends on a job boundary.

2. COLLAPSE the 5 per-extra cells + the union cell into ONE job that creates a FRESH VENV PER EXTRA. Environment isolation here comes from the venv, not the job boundary — `clean-core-wheel` already proves this by building its clean environment with `python -m venv /tmp/clean` inside a single job. The per-extra matrix today installs into the runner ambient python with no venv at all, so venv-per-extra is STRICTLY MORE ISOLATED than the status quo.

KEEP `clean-core-wheel` as its own job. It is the check credited in this file own header with catching "the module-scope-import class that escaped once", and it builds a real wheel rather than an editable install. Leaving the highest-value check structurally untouched is deliberate.

Rejected alternative: sequential `pip install .[agents]` then `.[eval]` into one shared python. This is the footgun that must never ship — after the first install the environment is contaminated, so a missing dependency declaration in a later extra would PASS silently. That is precisely the bug class this workflow exists to catch.
Rejected alternative: collapsing `clean-core-wheel` in too — more slot savings, but it concentrates the one check with a proven escape history into shared machinery.

## Scope
- `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml` — remove the `import-linter` job; replace the `per-extra` matrix and the `union` job with one job looping over the extras, each in its own venv.

Explicitly NOT in scope: `clean-core-wheel` (unchanged), `_build-and-test.yml`, and `gerrit-verify.yaml` (the caller references the reusable by name, not by inner job).

## Testing
No new testable behavior in the library — this is CI workflow configuration. The contract is preserved by construction (venv per extra) and is verified by RUNNING it: `optionality.yml` triggers on `pull_request`, and for PR events GitHub resolves a `./` reusable from the PR merge ref rather than the default branch, so a throwaway PR against the GitHub mirror genuinely exercises the modified reusable end-to-end pre-merge. That is the validation path, and it is available here even though the Gerrit `workflow_dispatch` lane cannot exercise workflow changes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each extra is installed into its own freshly-created venv, never into a venv or python that already had another extra installed.
- [ ] The set of extras exercised is unchanged from the current matrix, and the union case is still exercised.
- [ ] One failing extra does not prevent the remaining extras from being exercised in the same run, and the job still fails overall.
- [ ] The `clean-core-wheel` job is unmodified.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py` and `tests/unit/test_optional.py` still run in the default suite (they are the coverage the deleted `import-linter` job provided).
- [ ] `python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` passes.
- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` passes.
- [ ] `make lint` passes (actionlint covers all workflows).
data.title: Collapse the optionality per-extra fan-out into one venv-per-extra job
